info.title: TCPGecko Plugin
info.author: Katope
info.description: TCP Gecko server ported to a Wii U Aroma
info.details:
TCPGecko Plugin is a Wii U Aroma plugin that exposes a TCP Gecko-compatible server for development, debugging, memory inspection workflows.

Credits
This project is a fork of BullyWiiPlaza/tcpgecko, adapted for use as an Aroma plugin by Katope. This project also contains work from TCP Gecko and Wii U homebrew contributors; individual source files retain their applicable copyright and license notices.

License

This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo.

changelog:
Initial public release of TCPGecko Plugin for Aroma.

Highlights:

Updated Aroma plugin build environment.
Improved title-switch cleanup and socket lifecycle.
Preserved global-buffer kernel-copy staging with chunked transfers.
Added English and Japanese documentation.
